corrections.description: A duplicate connection is not an edit. The donor pushes a no-op undo step and counts an edit, so the next undo appears to do nothing. The port records nothing, and the next undo reverts the real connection.

A storyboard group keeps its re-anchored outside edges across a save and reload. The donor's load normalization drops every edge touching a group node (groups have no handles), so a reloaded storyboard loses those connections and ungrouping cannot restore them. The port keeps and restores them.
